examples.japanese: {菜箸|さいばし}で{天|てん}ぷらを{揚|あ}げた。
examples.english: I fried tempura using cooking chopsticks.

examples.japanese: {菜箸|さいばし}は{普通|ふつう}の{箸|はし}より{長|なが}い。
examples.english: Cooking chopsticks are longer than regular chopsticks.

examples.japanese: {熱|あつ}い{油|あぶら}に{手|て}を{近|ちか}づけないように、{菜箸|さいばし}を{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used cooking chopsticks to keep my hands away from the hot oil.

notes:
{菜箸|さいばし} are extra-long chopsticks (usually 30-40cm) designed for cooking. They keep hands at a safe distance from heat and allow precise handling of ingredients.

Common uses:
- {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}をする (frying)
- {炒|いた}め{物|もの}を{作|つく}る (stir-frying)
- {茹|ゆ}でた{麺|めん}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す (removing boiled noodles)

{菜箸|さいばし} are typically made of bamboo, wood, or heat-resistant plastic. Some have silicone tips for use with non-stick cookware.
